quote: Results show that the structure-aware Transformer retrofitted via our proposed middle-layer training strategy achieves better language perplexity, meanwhile inducing high-quality syntactic phrases.

We measure the perplexity on masked words... retrofitted Transformer yields better language perplexity in both unsupervised (37.0) or supervised (29.2) manner. ... Our retrofitted Transformer LM gives the best performance (60.3% F1) in unsupervised induction... highest F1 score (68.8%).
